content: Secrets features beyond base sops-nix seen in personal nix configs (single-source, LOW): EmergentMind keeps a separate PRIVATE git repo (nix-secrets) as a flake input so the public config repo stays public while secrets are encrypted - needs the private repo cloned on each machine before rebuild (extra bootstrap step). frankper adds a per-host inner validation justfile target that checks every host with enableSops has an &anchor and every path_regex resolves (catches stale rules); nicolkrit999 documents 'operate from the WORKSTATION' model: user age key in every rule is what makes rekeying from one machine possible (sect size small, single admin). Deterministic, meaningful pattern: escape hatch admin key + master workstation workflow. git-agecrypt mentioned by sops-nix README for hooking into git. Not recommended for v1: sops-nix 'push' mode over SSH, gnupg backend, per-secret sopsFile sprawl.
